title: Check yourself: What the run knows: context, independence and the practice

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: A review job runs on every push and keeps posting remarks that the author has already fixed. What fixes it?

options.text: Raise the turn limit so that the run can compare with earlier comments
options.says: Ruled out because "A CI run does not remember the last one", and a longer loop does not change that.

options.text: Put earlier reports in the prompt and ask for new issues only
options.says: A run has no memory of the last one, so what was reported must be in the prompt.

options.text: Tell the reviewer to be more conservative about what it reports
options.says: Ruled out because such wording does not change what a reviewer reports, since vague instructions "leave the threshold unstated".

options.text: Run the review inside the session that wrote the change
options.says: Ruled out because the writing session is "less effective at reviewing its own changes" and still would not know what was said on earlier pushes.

origin.section: A re-run needs memory it does not have

questions.stem: A job that drafts additional checks keeps proposing situations that are already exercised. What belongs in its prompt?

options.text: A request for many more checks so that coverage becomes certain
options.says: Ruled out because more proposals add duplicates, while the aim is "so that suggestions do not duplicate covered scenarios".

options.text: The production code alone, to keep the whole prompt short
options.says: Ruled out because without the tests the run cannot see what is covered: "put the existing tests in the prompt".

options.text: A lower turn limit, so that fewer proposals come back at all
options.says: Ruled out because a record of earlier work carried by the prompt "is the only state the pipeline has", and a turn limit adds none.

options.text: The test files that exist, plus a request to skip covered cases
options.says: The remedy is to show the run what the suite already covers.
